class Witness:
 def __init__(self):
  self.sequence=0;self.previous='0'*64
 def emit(self,payload):
  self.sequence+=1
  assert self.sequence<=512
  content=canonical(payload);assert len(content.encode())<=131072
  digest=hashlib.sha256(content.encode()).hexdigest()
  chain=hashlib.sha256((self.previous+':'+digest).encode()).hexdigest()
  frame={'kind':'oi7-causal-witness/1','sequence':self.sequence,'previous_sha256':self.previous,'payload_sha256':digest,'chain_sha256':chain,'payload':payload}
  line=canonical(frame);assert len(line.encode())<=132096
  sys.stdout.write(line+'\n');sys.stdout.flush()
  self.previous=chain
